document.about: Federal Reserve Monetary Policy Report, July 2024. Its charts stand in a column beside the text, each with a scale of numbers set level with its axis's ticks, lined up with the lines of the paragraph beside it.

notes: 2026-11-26: the text column's lines and the chart's scale beside them were read as one table, a line of the paragraph to a row with a scale value (`… and fell | 4`); what the table left of the paragraph was taken by the chart as its labels.

checks.text: investment declined steeply in 2022 and fell further in the first half of last year
